name: tweet-card
title: Tweet Card
description: Server-side component that fetches and renders a tweet by ID using react-tweet API. Includes author info, verified badge, linked entities (URLs, hashtags), and media. Wraps result with Suspense and supports custom error handling and…
use: Embedding tweets in articles, testimonials, or social proof sections where live tweet rendering is desired.
avoid: Client-side-only apps without server rendering capability; the component requires server-side data fetching.
a11y: Accessible tweet structure with semantic markup for author, content, and links. Photos and videos have alt text and proper media attributes.
